title: Splunk Security Advisories - 2025-11-26
description:
Merged 2 splunk security advisories published on 2025-11-26. Original advisory IDs: SVD-2025-1105, SVD-2025-1104

Titles:
- Sensitive Information Disclosure in “_internal“ index through Splunk Add-On for Palo Alto Networks
- Third-Party Package Updates in Splunk SOAR - November 2025

affected_products.product: Splunk Add-on for Palo Alto Networks

remediations.description:
Upgrade Splunk Add-On for Palo Alto Networks to version 2.0.2, 3.0.0, or higher and determine if any credentials are exposed in plain text:
1. In Search and Reporting, search for
index="_internal" sourcetype="splunk_ta_paloalto_networks*"
2. Immediately generate a new
client_id
and
client_secret
as needed, and revoke any that have been exposed as a result of this vulnerability.
